title: Reverse-Seared {p} with {v}
steps: {?bakingpotato:Scrub the {s}, prick with a fork, and bake at 425°F (220°C) for 45 to 60 minutes. Then lower the oven to 250°F (120°C).}{?!bakingpotato:Heat the oven to 250°F (120°C).} Pat the {p} very dry and season well with salt.

Set the {p} on a rack over a baking sheet and bake until the center is about 15°F under the finish you want, usually 25 to 45 minutes. Check with a thermometer. The USDA safe minimum for steak is 145°F / 63°C, so for that finish pull the steaks at about 130°F (54°C). A lower doneness is your choice and carries more risk.
While the steaks bake, cook the {v} on the stove, any way you like: steam, sauté or boil.{?!bakingpotato: Cook the {s} the way you like it too.}
Heat a heavy pan until smoking and sear the {p} 1 minute on the first side. Flip, add the {sauce} and the {spice}, and baste for about a minute.
Sear the edges briefly, then rest the {p} 5 to 7 minutes and slice against the grain. Serve with the {v} and {s}.
tip: Keep the steak to a palm-size portion, and put the vegetable on half the plate.
